text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Licensing Tribunal must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal. The Nominating Panel - Toronto Licensing Tribunal will conduct interviews at its next meeting and will recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Licensing Tribunal: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal: Candidate TLT2-216 Candidate TLT2-223 Candidate TLT2-225 Candidate TLT2-238 Candidate TLT2-247 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (March 26, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Licensing Tribunal.
